headline: Congress named a Frisco, Colorado post office building after Patrick E. Mahany, Jr.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 35 West Main Street in Frisco, Colorado. The building is now officially called the "Patrick E. Mahany, Jr., Post Office Building." It does not change how the post office operates or what services it offers.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2018.
